Name: S1.1 see whether a lumbar MRI order needs prior auth, and what documentation is required, while the order is still open
Description: As a prior-auth coordinator, I want to see whether a lumbar MRI order needs prior auth, and what documentation is required, while the order is still open, so that I don't check a portal later.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a clinician signs an order for CPT 72148 for a member of a plan in scope
When the order is signed
Then the order shows "Prior auth required: documentation needed" within 2 seconds at the 95th percentile
And the card links to the questionnaire

Given the coverage service is down
When the order is signed
Then the order shows "Could not check: use the portal" and the order is never blocked

Name: S1.2 a clear "No prior auth needed" result with a reference number
Description: As a coordinator, I want a clear "No prior auth needed" result with a reference number, so that I can schedule straight away.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the service does not need prior auth for this member
When the order is signed
Then the card says "No prior auth needed" with a reference number and date
And the reference is saved on the order

Name: S2.1 the plan's questions pre-filled from the chart
Description: As a coordinator, I want the plan's questions pre-filled from the chart, so that I don't re-type what is already there.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the chart has a back-pain diagnosis with an onset date, coded PT visits or an NSAID prescription
When the questionnaire opens
Then diagnosis, weeks of pain and weeks of conservative care are filled in
And each filled answer is marked "from chart"

Given a value is not in the chart as data
When the questionnaire opens
Then that question is left blank, never guessed

Name: S2.2 each pre-filled answer to show where it came from
Description: As a nurse reviewer, I want each pre-filled answer to show where it came from, so that I can trust it without opening every document.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given an answer was pre-filled
When the reviewer opens the request
Then the answer shows its source, for example "PT visit 10 Sep 2026" or "Ibuprofen 3 Sep to 29 Oct"

Name: S2.3 "no red flags" to be something I confirm, not something the system assumes from a blank chart
Description: As an ordering clinician, I want "no red flags" to be something I confirm, not something the system assumes from a blank chart, so that the request is accurate.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given no red-flag condition is coded in the chart
When the questionnaire opens
Then the red-flag question is left for the clinician, not filled as "none"

Given a red-flag condition is coded (for example history of cancer)
When the questionnaire opens
Then the red-flag answer is filled with that condition and marked "from chart"

Name: S2.4 the plan to read only the parts of my record it needs
Description: As a member, I want the plan to read only the parts of my record it needs, so that my privacy is respected.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the questionnaire rules run
When they query the chart
Then they request only the resource types the questions need (HIPAA minimum necessary)
And every query is written to an audit log with user, time and purpose

Name: S3.1 a short list of only the unanswered required questions
Description: As a coordinator, I want a short list of only the unanswered required questions, so that I can finish the request in one sitting.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given required questions are unanswered
When I press Submit
Then submit is held and the missing items are listed with a one-line reason each
And answering them enables Submit

Given all required questions are answered
When I press Submit
Then the request is sent with no extra screen
Feature: F3 Ask only what is missing, before submit

Name: S3.2 confirm red flags with one tap inside the order
Description: As a clinician, I want to confirm red flags with one tap inside the order, so that I am not pulled back days later.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the red-flag question is unanswered
When the clinician signs the order
Then a one-tap prompt offers "None" or the listed red flags
And the answer records who confirmed it and when
Feature: F3 Ask only what is missing, before submit

Name: S3.3 I don't want to be asked about weeks of pain or treatment when a red flag already justifies the scan.
Description: As a coordinator, I don't want to be asked about weeks of pain or treatment when a red flag already justifies the scan.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a red flag is answered
When the questionnaire updates
Then the weeks-of-pain and weeks-of-treatment questions are hidden and not required
Feature: F3 Ask only what is missing, before submit

Name: S3.4 save a half-finished request and come back to it
Description: As a coordinator, I want to save a half-finished request and come back to it, so that I can wait for a missing note.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a request has unanswered items
When I choose Save draft
Then the draft and its answers are kept for 14 days and listed in my queue
Feature: F3 Ask only what is missing, before submit

Name: S4.1 submit the completed request electronically and get a tracking ID
Description: As a coordinator, I want to submit the completed request electronically and get a tracking ID, so that I never fax.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a complete request
When I press Submit
Then it is sent through the Prior Authorization API and a tracking ID comes back within 5 seconds
And a failed send is retried and shown clearly, never silently dropped
Feature: F4 Submit and track through the Prior Authorization API

Name: S4.2 coordinator or clinician, I want to see the request status and the date a decision is due
Description: As a member, coordinator or clinician, I want to see the request status and the date a decision is due, so that nobody has to call to ask.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a request is submitted as urgent
When anyone with access views it
Then it shows status and a decision due within 72 hours

Given a request is submitted as standard
When anyone with access views it
Then it shows a decision due within 7 calendar days
And status is also available to the member through the patient access API
Feature: F4 Submit and track through the Prior Authorization API

Name: S4.3 complete requests that clearly meet the rules approved in real time, and everything else sent to a clinician
Description: As a health plan, I want complete requests that clearly meet the rules approved in real time, and everything else sent to a clinician, so that we are fast and never auto-deny.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a complete request meets the rules
When it is received
Then it is approved within seconds with the rules that were met listed

Given a complete request does not meet the rules
When it is received
Then it goes to the clinician review queue and is never denied automatically
Feature: F4 Submit and track through the Prior Authorization API

Name: S5.1 a pend notice that lists exactly what is missing and how to send it
Description: As a coordinator, I want a pend notice that lists exactly what is missing and how to send it, so that I fix it in one try.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a request is pended for missing information
When the notice is sent
Then it names each missing item, for example "office note from the last 30 days", and links to upload it
Feature: F5 Specific reasons and what to send

Name: S5.2 a denial to state the specific reason and the appeal steps
Description: As a clinician, I want a denial to state the specific reason and the appeal steps, so that I know what to do next.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a clinician reviewer denies a request
When the decision is sent
Then it includes the specific reason, the criteria used, and how to appeal or request a peer-to-peer review
Feature: F5 Specific reasons and what to send

Name: S6.1 As the product team, we want a weekly view of first-pass complete rate, real-time decision rate and top missing items
Description: As the product team, we want a weekly view of first-pass complete rate, real-time decision rate and top missing items, so that we know what to fix next.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a week of requests
When the dashboard refreshes
Then it shows the three numbers by plan and service, with the top 5 missing items

Name: S7.1 As the product team, we want to test with clinical policy whether structured answers can replace the 30-day note for low-risk requests
Description: As the product team, we want to test with clinical policy whether structured answers can replace the 30-day note for low-risk requests, so that we remove the biggest remaining cause of pends.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a sample of 100 past pended requests
When clinical policy reviews them with and without the note
Then we record how often the note changed the decision, and decide keep, relax or drop
